'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name RIP Spice. Alex O'Shea / Thursday, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
